details.method: Reject conflicts determined solely by immutable/base and current-head identities before decoding an unneeded revision, while preserving the same atomic transaction.
details.when: A bounded execution adapter delegates conservative unknown-read submissions to a broader native content store.
details.counterexample: Known object read sets need the latest object map to test disjointness; an outside-transaction preflight alone cannot prevent concurrent drift.
details.trial_plan: At future adoption use a small snapshot budget and a legitimately grown current head; spy on decoding, require conflict before grown metadata is loaded and unchanged database; retain known-read merge and idempotency regressions.
